ARR-002.reference_answer: PoinTr 指出，真实应用中采集的点云常因三个原因而不完整：传感器分辨率有限（limited sensor resolution）、单一视角（single viewpoint）与遮挡（occlusion）。
ARR-002.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-004.reference_answer: SVDFormer 针对的是真实扫描点云的稀疏性（sparsity）与大尺度结构不完整性（large structural incompleteness）；其双路径设计还能处理高度稀疏的真实世界扫描（highly sparse real-world scans）。
ARR-004.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-009.reference_answer: PoinTr represents a point cloud as a set of unordered groups of points with position embeddings, converts it into a sequence of point proxies, and uses those proxies as the inputs of the transformer.
ARR-009.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-010.reference_answer: SnowflakeNet 的架构中包含 Snowflake Point Deconvolution（SPD，雪花点反卷积）模块；SPD 中引入 skip-transformer，用于学习最适合局部区域的点分裂模式。
ARR-010.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-011.reference_answer: SeedFormer introduces a new shape representation called Patch Seeds, which captures general structures from partial inputs and also preserves regional information of local patterns.
ARR-011.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-012.reference_answer: ProxyFormer 将点云划分为已有（输入）与缺失（待预测）两部分，两部分通过各自的 proxy 交换信息；它设计 missing part sensitive transformer，把随机正态分布转换为合理的位置信息，并用 proxy alignment 精修缺失 proxy，使预测结果对缺失部分的特征与位置更敏感。
ARR-012.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-013.reference_answer: The Self-structure Dual-Generator (SDG) consists of a pair of parallel refinement units called Structure Analysis and Similarity Alignment.
ARR-013.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-014.reference_answer: HyperRS（Hyper Refinement Stack）通过一系列超图学习阶段由粗到细地逐步捕获高阶相关性；A-HGNN（Anchor-based Hypergraph Neural Network）采用两阶段采样策略构建协同超图，以稳健地建模全局结构。
ARR-014.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-016.reference_answer: SnowflakeNet 主要使用 Chamfer distance（CD）作为损失函数：completion loss 是 {Pc, P1, P2, P3} 上四个 CD 损失之和，再与 partial matching loss 形式的 preservation loss 组合为 L = Lcompletion + λLpreservation。
ARR-016.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-018.reference_answer: 在 ShapeNet-55/34 上，ProxyFormer 输入的不完整点云为 2048 个点，完整点云包含 8192 个点。
ARR-018.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-019.reference_answer: Each ground-truth point cloud contains 16384 points, evenly sampled from the shape surface.

ARR-022.reference_answer: SnowflakeNet 的主要实验在两个广泛使用的基准上进行：PCN 与 Completion3D。
ARR-022.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-029.reference_answer: SVDFormer reports ShapeNet-34 results in Table 3 separately for 34 seen categories and 21 unseen categories with three metrics (CD, DCD and F1), and states it achieves the best performance in terms of all three metrics.
ARR-029.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-030.reference_answer: PointAttN 的 PCN 结果表采用 L1 版本的 Chamfer distance（CD）作为指标。
ARR-030.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-031.reference_answer: AdaPoinTr ablates the point-proxy formulation Fi = F'i + φ(pi): removing the positional embedding drops performance by 0.48, and replacing the mini-DGCNN feature extractor with PointNet drops it by 0.23.
ARR-031.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-036.reference_answer: PointAttN 是一个充分利用于点云补全的注意力机制的深度神经网络；其动机是扩大处理三维点云时的感受野，以更好地保留几何结构与上下文信息；它通过 cross-attention 与 self-attention 感知局部细节与全局上下文，从而消除了 kNN 之类的显式局部区域划分。
ARR-036.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-039.reference_answer: SnowflakeNet uses a skip-transformer inside Snowflake Point Deconvolution (SPD): attention summarizes the point-splitting patterns used in the previous SPD layer to produce the splitting in the current layer. PointAttN instead uses self-attention and cross-attention to capture local details and global context, with a geometric details perception (GDP) block applying cross-attention between original and down-sampled features, which removes explicit local region partition such as kNN.
ARR-039.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-007.reference_answer: The PCN decoder produces two outputs: a coarse output point cloud Ycoarse and a detailed output point cloud Ydetail, with the coarse output generated first.
ARR-007.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-037.reference_answer: PoinTr replaces fixed queries with dynamic queries generated by a query generation module that summarizes encoder features and represents the initial sketch of the missing points. AdaPoinTr likewise adopts dynamic query embeddings in the decoder, in contrast to the learnable static query embedding of prior work, which makes the decoder more flexible and adjustable for different objects and their missing information.
ARR-037.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)

ARR-040.reference_answer: SVDFormer 通过 Self-structure Dual-Generator 结合学习到的形状先验与几何自相似性建模结构关系：Structure Analysis 单元显式编码粗点云的局部不完整性，Similarity Alignment 单元为每个点寻找相似结构的特征。Hyper-PCN 则用超图显式建模点云内部复杂的高阶相关性：HyperRS 由粗到细逐步捕获高阶相关性，A-HGNN 以两阶段采样构建协同超图来稳健建模全局结构。
ARR-040.source: derived from gold chunk content (verified source truth)
